       Senior Engineer - Valdel Engineers and Constructors Pvt Ltd (November 2018 – Till Date)

                     Associate Engineer - HCL Services Ltd (November 2016 to June 2018)

 ⮚ Installed and configured desktops, laptops, and peripherals.
 ⮚ Provided L1 technical assistance for endpoint devices, operating systems, enterprise applications, and
    network connectivity, resolving incidents through remote and onsite support.
 ⮚ Coordinated with vendors for hardware and software procurement, repairs, and service requests,
    ensuring timely delivery and adherence to organizational requirements.

    Desktop Support Engineer - Rk InfoTech Systems (November 2013 to November 2015)

 ⮚  Installed new systems and assisted with workstation relocations.
 ⮚  Collaborated with IT teams to improve system performance and stability.
 ⮚  Relocated users to new workstations, including moving and connecting assigned equipment
